TC consumes ETF holdings capability/source lineage from staging; stale last-known holdings remain display-only and do not become current analytic input.
The TC workstation supports its benchmark-to-sector/industry/constituent flow, Market Map, breadth, ratios, and historical analytics over persisted evidence with explicit gaps and provenance.
The existing TC Python/DSL/Study/Strategy engine remains the single programming model, immutable and lineage-preserving, with compatible promotions and explicit capability errors.
Mapped V25 reference states and the workstation interaction model are implemented and validated without weakening visual or functional oracles.
Golden Layout/window resilience, accessibility, security, sandbox, endurance, dense-data performance, migration, and logging checks provide actionable evidence.

After both upstream branches reach staging, every intersecting path has a line-level semantic disposition and the TC branch passes exact-tip validation or records a precise reproducible external blocker.
The branch stops at ready_for_human_review with clean, synchronized TC-owned workstream records and no direct branch merge, deployment, or mutation of another worktree.
